competition: 2026青年AI音乐嘉年华·单曲组·提报口径：青春理想×成长经历（朋友间的鼓励与陪伴）

target.key_strategy: C major overall, A minor-flavored bridge, final chorus modulates up a whole step to D major
target.vocal_range: female lead A3-C5; final chorus peaks B4 with choir support; male fallback down 3-4 semitones

lead_voice.timbre: bright, warm, plainspoken young female lead, no grit, no scream
lead_voice.narrative_role: first-person friend comforting the listener; intro/outro hook sung softly like coaxing; bridge confessional

hook.strategy: sentence-level repetition only: hook pair (lines 1,3) verbatim; chorus 2 upgrades content lines (你回头的时候我在/照样出来/一起嗨/唱到天亮起来); final chorus upgrades again (为你出来/唱起来) with whole-step lift; no whole-section verbatim repeats (L8)
